committees.name: Conference Committee
committees.notes: Registration at 160 (35 exhibitors/sponsors). Keynote Rustin Moore signed. PetDesk secured as new sponsor. Conference & pre-conference schedule largely finalized.
committees.nextSteps: Finalize Thursday night community event, book signing, moderator assignments, and Recover session.

committees.name: JAVTE
committees.currentFocus: Summer edition to Portland; building the reviewer bench
committees.notes: June meeting finalized the summer print edition, with a backlog of articles held for future editions. Welcomed a new slate of reviewers, now 8 across 4 teams, to speed review. New 2026-2027 reviewer slate released; new rubrics created for Case Studies, Tips and Tricks, and Articles; submission-tracking spreadsheet shared with Maddie and Michele.
committees.nextSteps: Recruit authors via an AVTE Portland presentation (Amanda Hackerott and Oreta Samples); continue adding content and content areas. Meet in September to plan the Fall edition.

committees.name: Resource Exchange
committees.notes: Meeting monthly with AVTE Admin (Lisa and Michele) to align on Resource Exchange activity. Created a full-year community engagement calendar to drive library uploads; planning a conference round table on navigating the platform and a contest to spur activity during the conference.
committees.nextSteps: Upload YouTube videos and JAVTE articles; run the contest, round table, and booth at the conference; keep moving Facebook conversations and resources onto the platform; implement the engagement calendar.

committees.name: Veterinary Technician Education Specialist (VTES)
committees.notes: Committee meets regularly, updating online resources and editing the VTES exam while working with the FVTE Committee to clarify each credential's value. Updated the points/qualification resources and online application; now reviewing and updating the current exam version to be ready for candidates at or around the conference. Two candidates approved, one pending.
committees.nextSteps: After the exam update and conference (with a table promoting VTES and FVTE), build out the question library for multiple exam versions, create a proctored off-conference exam process, and promote the credential.

committees.name: Awards Committee
committees.notes: No update this cycle. The Awards Committee's work is complete at this time.

committees.name: Advocacy Committee

committees.name: Leadership Development Committee

committees.name: Sponsorship Committee
committees.currentFocus: Reframing sponsorship as partnership in AVTE's programs

Building a postcard highlighting new program initiatives with an invitation to join the industry and leadership development journey.
committees.nextSteps: Share postcards with exhibitors and sponsors at the conference and collect contact information for August/September follow-up.

committees.name: Fellows in Veterinary Technician Education (FVTE)

committees.nextSteps: Ensure the assessment process and rubrics are efficient for committee reviewers.

committees.name: Vet Tech Fall Faculty Academy
committees.currentFocus: Finalizing plan to announce in Portland
committees.notes: Two-day virtual intensive. Launch: week after Labor Day 2026. Cohort: 25 to 30 new vet tech faculty. Fee: $50 to $75. Mentorship through December. Co-Directors confirmed: Rebecca Newman (Appalachian State) and Laura Boarman (Owensboro CC). Third co-director role still needed. Group continues to meet. Identified questions for the program directors survey to aid program development, the questions were included and the results shared back with the volunteer leads.
committees.nextSteps: Use the survey results to shape the program. Board approval of concept. Confirm third Co-Director. Finalize registration fee and marketing plan. Announce in Portland.

committees.currentFocus: Finalizing program concept to announce in Portland
committees.notes: 11-month virtual webinar series, September to July, one session per CVTEA Accreditation Standard. Karla Lombana has agreed to co-chair. Recruiting a co-chair partner for the effort. Feeds into Resource Exchange discussion threads.
committees.nextSteps: Recruit a co-chair partner to join Karla Lombana. Board discussion and approval. Recruit presenters for Standards 1 to 4. Set up Resource Exchange threads.
